all_original_human_adjudication_fields.method: Independent decisions against the literal asks, fixed key, prebound map and full frozen summary. Entire same-entry content counts, including attached quotations. Only requested pairs were adjudicated. No browsing, other file reads, delegation, reader contact, input modification, answer repair or new reader run. Original proposals were treated as proposals, not authority. Fact indices are one-based within each mapped clause.
